title: Rule Federation model
description: A central baseline ruleset and the domains that adopt it — the machine-readable model behind a federated API governance rule registry.

central.description: The central baseline the federation shares.

owner.description: The accountable central owner of the baseline.

code.description: Stable rule identifier, matched by domain adoptions.

severity.description: The baseline severity the center holds.

steward.description: Who owns this rule centrally. A rule with no steward is a liability.

rationale.description: Why the API pattern this rule governs actually matters — the storytelling that makes change stick.

conversation.description: The issue/PR/thread where this rule is discussed.

roadmap.description: A planned change to the rule.

adoptVia.description: Copy-paste snippet showing how the domain extends the baseline by reference.

code.description: References a central rule; for a local rule, the domain's own code.

severity.description: Required for override and local; the domain's effective severity.

reason.description: Why the domain deviates. A deviation with no reason is undocumented — the tool flags it.

proposePromotion.description: Local rule only — the domain proposes the center adopt this into the baseline.
